fullPassage: You can actually become your own cheerleader by talking to yourself positively and then acting as if you were already the person that you wanted to be. Act as though you were trying out for the role of a positive, cheerful, happy, and likable person. Walk, talk, and act as if you were already that person. Treat everyone you meet as though you had just won an award for being the very best person in your industry or as though you had just won the lottery. You will be amazed at how much better you feel about yourself after just a few minutes of pretending.

You will be (C)[amazed / disappointed] at how much better you feel about yourself after just a few minutes of pretending.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) positively(긍정적으로), (B) cheerful(쾌활한), (C) amazed(놀란) — 원문 일치
det.analysis:
✅ ① positively — cheerful — amazed: 원문 그대로
❌ ② negatively — cheerful — amazed: negatively는 positively의 반의어
❌ ③ positively — gloomy — amazed: gloomy는 cheerful의 반의어
❌ ④ positively — cheerful — disappointed: disappointed는 amazed의 반의 뉘앙스
det.tip: positively↔negatively, cheerful↔gloomy, amazed↔disappointed

❌ ④ competing with your rivals: 경쟁, 자기 격려 맥락과 불일치
det.tip: become your own cheerleader by ~ = ~함으로써 자신의 응원자가 되다. 자기긍정 발화가 핵심.

questions.passage: You can actually __________ by talking to yourself positively and then acting as if you were already the person that you wanted to be. Act as though you were trying out for the role of a positive, cheerful, happy, and likable person. Walk, talk, and act as if you were already that person. Treat everyone you meet as though you had just won an award for being the very best person in your industry or as though you had just won the lottery. You will be amazed at how much better you feel about yourself after just a few minutes of pretending.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: become your own cheerleader(자신의 응원자가 되다) — 자기긍정 발화를 통해 자신을 격려하는 주체가 된다는 본문의 핵심 메시지.
det.analysis:

❌ ③ hide your true feelings: 감정 숨김, 자기긍정과 무관
